verdict.rationale: A remote-display app could plausibly expose a public control API, so this axis applies. The evidence documents only touch, keyboard and Pencil interaction, plus Homebrew install and build-from-source commands; none of these is an API for programmatically driving the product. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
